integrity: Symbolic Kunz proof and standalone bounded exhaustive checker; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: No count at higher genera or Frobenius lines F>=3m+3.
Finite checker is supporting evidence, not an infinite proof.
Unindexed historical literature remains a priority risk.
scientific_scope: Complete minimum-genus and irreducible classification only for F=3m+1 (m>=2) and F=3m+2 (m>=3).
title: Boolean classification of minimum-genus semigroups immediately beyond the one-third Frobenius threshold
